info.name: Contacts Hub
info.summary: Sync your Nextcloud address books with iCloud, Infomaniak, Mailo and any other CardDAV service
info.description:
Turn your Nextcloud address books into a contacts hub.
Contacts Hub syncs any Nextcloud address book with external CardDAV server -- one-way, in either direction. Because every job runs through a Nextcloud address book, you can also use Nextcloud as a bridge between two external services that have no way of talking to each other directly.
* **One-to-many.** Push one address book out to as many services as you like. * **Duplicate detection.** A new contact that looks like an existing one -- same name plus a shared email or phone, under a different UID -- is flagged for you instead of being guessed at. * **Deletions are your call.** Mirror them, or archive the contact into a group instead of removing it. * **Snapshots** are taken automatically before any sync that actually writes, so a bad run is always undoable. * **Interrupted runs resume themselves** rather than losing track of where they were.
Contacts stay where they belong: in Nextcloud's own address books, editable in the Contacts app and reachable from every CardDAV client you already use.
info.author: Gérard Kieffer
